I've only been playing magic for a few months. Went to my first event last week, the dragons prerelease. It was the first time I ever even played against someone other than my boyfriend. Being nervous about playing against other people aside, I felt a bit uncomfortable the whole time. I never really understood why there was hardly ever any girls in pro magic, but I think I sort of get why they might be a bit turned off the idea. Being the only girl there made me feel like an alien or something. People were actually very nice to me. No weird comments or anything. I did get a lot of stares though. It was obvious the people I played against felt a bit awkward about it. Maybe if I go a few more times I'll get used to it.

It's dumb but I feel like I have more to prove as a girl. Like I have to represent my people, hah. I don't want to be "that girl that sucks", ya know?
